extensions.platform: Android Jetpack Compose Material 3. HTML snippets are documentation previews; native source is authoritative.

body.purpose: Selectable document paragraphs with Android multilingual fallback.

components.name: Settings group
components.css: .ds-settings{background:#F0F4EF;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}.ds-settings button{display:grid;gap:3px;text-align:left;padding:18px 20px;min-height:48px;background:transparent;border:0;width:100%;color:#19221E;font:500 15px/22px sans-serif}.ds-settings button+button{border-top:1px solid #C1C9C1}.ds-settings span{color:#414943;font:400 15px/23px sans-serif}.ds-settings button:hover{background:#E4E9E3}.ds-settings button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #006B58;outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Recording row
components.css: .ds-project{display:grid;width:100%;gap:5px;text-align:left;padding:12px 0;background:#FAFBF9;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #C1C9C1;color:#19221E;font:400 13px/20px sans-serif}.ds-project strong{font:600 17px/24px sans-serif}.ds-project span{color:#414943}.ds-project span:last-child{color:#006B58}.ds-project:hover{background:#F0F4EF}.ds-project:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #006B58}

narrative.overview: Transcriptor feels like a well arranged document library. Recordings, models, and settings have distinct destinations; transcript text receives the most generous space. Native Material 3 controls provide predictable interaction, while measured typography and restrained green accents give the app its identity.
keyCharacteristics: Clear reading hierarchy with system text scaling and Arabic fallback.
Flat lists, generous margins, and grouped settings with explicit labels.
Persistent system, light, and dark appearance.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Use accent for actions and state; keep long text on neutral surfaces.

rules.name: The Text First Rule
rules.body: A transcript is a document: preserve continuous selectable paragraphs and apply search highlights within the surrounding text.

dos: Do use native Material components and predictable Back behavior.
Do preserve multilingual, enlarged-text, light, and dark behavior.
Do keep controls discoverable while giving transcript text room.
Do use the bundled Lucide vectors with accessible names on standalone actions.
donts: Don't replace document structure with nested card stacks.
Don't fabricate progress, model claims, or language specialization for generic models.
Don't hide failed actions or discard cue timings, speakers, or original text.
